title: Jesus' resurrection
description: Early on the first day of the week, the women come to the tomb and find it empty. Angels proclaim: "He is not here; he has risen!" Jesus appears to Mary Magdalene, and the message is brought to the disciples.

versions.title: Jesus' resurrection
versions.description: The women come to the tomb and find it empty. Angels proclaim: "He is not here; he has risen!" Jesus appears to Mary Magdalene and the other women.
versions.reason: [major] category: The category 'Jesus' suffering' does not fit the resurrection. Thematically, the resurrection belongs under 'life of Jesus', since 'Jesus' suffering' typically covers the passion narrative up to the crucifixion and burial.
